About.title: About
About.heading: About Spexipedia
About.description: Spexipedia is provided by FGV and is the Chalmers spex encyclopedia: the spex through the years, their characters, music, scenography and traditions.
About.feedbackDescription: We value your opinion. Do you have suggestions for improvements or have you found a bug? Get in touch at {email}.

Support.title: Support
Support.heading: How can we help?
Support.description: Have you found a technical fault, or trouble logging in or editing a page? We are happy to help.
Support.contactDescription: Describe your problem as clearly as possible. Get in touch at {email}.

AdminKinds.title: Kinds
AdminKinds.description: The kinds the spex pages and the import use: names in Swedish and English, the spellings the import recognises, their order (the first in use is the default) and whether they are in use.

typeHelp.NUMBER: What a number is, e.g. song, overture or finale. A number may have none.
typeHelp.CREDIT: What someone did for a number, e.g. lyrics, music or arrangement. Spexify, Spexarkivet and Spexflix read them from the feed.
typeHelp.IMAGE: Image kinds per use: for characters, for scenography and for the page’s other images. The uses are fixed; the kinds within them are data.
typeHelp.FACT: Short facts about a production, as text or as a date. A new kind of fact shows at once when spex pages are edited.

AdminKinds.aliasesHelp: One per line: other spellings the import recognises, e.g. “Låt” for Song.
AdminKinds.mergeText: Everything of this kind gets the other, and its names become aliases there. The kind is deleted; this cannot be undone.

Packages.title: Import
Packages.description: A new spex in every FGV application from a spreadsheet and a zip: preview what happens in each application, then apply it.
Packages.newDescription: Fill in the template and put the files (posters, images, manuscripts, recordings, photos) in a zip. The zip may be up to 20 GB; if it does not all upload, you can continue later.
Packages.previewFirst: Preview the import to see what happens in each application before it is applied.
Packages.recordsAndFiles: {records, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}, {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
Packages.itemsWithMessages: {count, plural, one {# record with a message} other {# records with messages}}
Packages.unmatched: {count, plural, one {# file or row goes nowhere} other {# files and rows go nowhere}}
Packages.zipHelp: Up to 20 GB. The file names in the zip are given in the spreadsheet.
Packages.zipFailed: The zip did not all arrive ({message}); continue on the import’s page.
Packages.zipIncomplete: The zip {name} has not all arrived.
Packages.pickSameZip: Pick the same zip again and the upload continues where it stopped.
Packages.notTheSameZip: That is not the same zip: expected {name} of {size}.
Packages.applyText: Spexipedia first, then the other applications. It can be applied again; what is already there is not changed twice.
Packages.deleteText: The import and its files are deleted. What it created stays.
